cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put your bag over your head against the rain; I'll carry your book bag that way too. No trouble, though the corners are firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's waterproof. That's a paper bag of dictionaries. Let me take it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, waterproofing. I'll wrap it in my coat. Please, keep your hands free for the tickets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have to cross the bridge now. You can't hold that bundle up in this wind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right. I'll carry it under my coat instead. You lead the way; I don't mind a little rain down my collar.
